description: OPTIONAL colours and logo for a site whose owner is not a designer. Writes three prompts the owner pastes into the design tool she likes (three palettes, five variations of a simple SVG mark, a download package of her favourite), then checks what comes back with code and installs it: contrast of every text colour on every background in both themes, SVG safety, the seven icon files, the theme tokens, the share cards. Refuses and names the problem instead of adjusting anything silently; puts every file back if the site's tests go red. Never runs unasked: asked once after positioning, or run later on an existing site. Trigger phrases: "I need a logo", "pick colours", "colour palette", "brand colours", "favicon", "app icons", "my logo as the favicon", "install my logo", "new colours for the site", "does my palette pass contrast". Not for a tagline, fonts, a raster (PNG/JPG) logo, generated photos (image), or the share-card design (og-images).
